task: Simplify the delete-voice confirmation UX. The UI must ask only for the literal word DELETE; remove all user-facing voice_id instructions and do not require the ID. Preserve the existing active-profile/stale-callback, path, reparse and data-safety protections. The delete handler must accept only case-insensitive trimmed DELETE (no IDs, no alternate phrases), and keep refusing any other value. Update focused tests and labels/status text accordingly. Run py_compile, all profile/upload tests, build_ui smoke and git diff --check. Do not delete any real profile/audio data during validation, do not run migration/preparation/training/generation, do not change dependencies or .git metadata, and do not commit/push in the Executor task.
constraints: Canonical biel4 App Server/headless Executor only; no native subagents, create_thread, alternate backend, TUI or direct fallback.
Edit only app.py and focused tests; preserve all real voice/profile/audio data.
No destructive action, dependency install, commit or push.

review_findings.title: Delete confirmation is too technical
review_findings.details: The current label asks the user to type a voice_id or DELETE <voice_id>. Replace it with a single simple DELETE confirmation while keeping strict rejection of all other input.
